flags.why: This verb belongs to formal institutional usage and needs a formal register warning.
Calling someone tối dạ disparages their intelligence and can insult them.
Trẽn means embarrassed or abashed, rather than habitually shy or timid ([dictionary](https://tudientv.com/?t=tr%E1%BA%BDn)).
The example presents trẽn as a shy personality trait rather than embarrassment in a particular situation.
flags.fix: Bị phát hiện nói dối, anh ta cười cho đỡ trẽn. = Caught lying, he smiled to cover his embarrassment.

flags.why: Lường gạt is an ordinary current expression for cheating or swindling, so rare misleads learners about its usage.
